prompt: How old was the United States Air Force when the 317th Fighter-Interceptor Squadron was inactivated, rounded to the nearest year?
answer:
The U.S. Air Force was established on **September 18, 1947**. The 317th Fighter-Interceptor Squadron was inactivated on **December 31, 1969**.

That makes the Air Force approximately **22 years old**, rounded to the nearest year.
